pairings.description: Cumin's warm, earthy notes complement the smoky spiciness of chili powder, enhancing the depth of flavor in dishes like chili and tacos.
Though a sweeter spice, cardamom can add an intriguing aromatic layer to chili powder, providing a contrasting sweetness that balances heat in certain dishes.
Caraway's anise-like flavor can introduce a unique twist when paired with chili powder, especially in stews and braised dishes, adding complexity to the profile.
